name: VIZBL
description:
Vizbl turns 3D models into web-ready AR experiences that customers can view in their browser or place in their own space on a phone — no app install required.

With this connector, Claude can take a 3D model you attach or link to and put it straight into your Vizbl account, then hand you back a live viewer link. Instead of switching to a dashboard, uploading by hand, and waiting on a conversion queue, you describe what you want and Claude does the round trip.

What it can do:

• Import a 3D model into your Vizbl library from a download URL, including multi-variant imports where several files belong to one product (for example colour or material options, imported as an ordered set).
• Report the status of an import job at any moment — current stage, warnings, errors, and the resulting object id and viewer URL.
• Wait for an import to finish and return the final result, so a conversion that takes a while doesn't need repeated checking.
• Delete an object from your Vizbl library when it is no longer needed.

Requires a Vizbl account and a Developer API key, which you create in your Vizbl dashboard and enter when connecting. All actions run against your own library, scoped to that key's permissions.

_published_faq.name: How do I add VIZBL to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add VIZBL to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.vizbl.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the VIZBL MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: VIZBL provides these MCP tools: vizbl_delete_object, vizbl_get_import, vizbl_import_model, and vizbl_wait_import.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to VIZBL?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to VIZBL in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
VIZBL requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
VIZBL is developed by Vizbl. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
